evals.prompt: Create a GitHub Actions workflow to automatically archive my GitHub repository traffic every week so I never lose data after 14 days.
evals.expected_output: Produces .github/workflows/gitlytics-traffic.yml using ameyachopade/gitlytics-github-traffic-automation@v1.2.0 with ${{ secrets.TRAFFIC_TOKEN }}, minimal contents: write permission, and public_only safety.
assertions: Uses ${{ secrets.TRAFFIC_TOKEN }} and never hardcodes a token
Schedules more frequently than 14 days and includes workflow_dispatch

evals.prompt: How do I run the Gitlytics dashboard locally against my archived ./data CSV folder, and what do I need to watch out for if I expose it on my LAN?
evals.expected_output: Explains pip install "gitlytics[dashboard]", safe loopback default gitlytics dashboard --data-dir ./data, and warns that --public-bind disables preloaded tokens and requires an authenticated reverse proxy or private network.
assertions: Warns about --public-bind disabling preloaded tokens and lacking built-in auth
